name: Daniel Hayes
bio:
Daniel Hayes's career began not in motorsport, but in the demanding world of high-frequency trading. He honed his skills managing complex IT infrastructure for a Chicago-based firm, developing a keen eye for detail and an intolerance for downtime. A lifelong racing fan, he made the leap to motorsport five years ago, drawn by the unique challenges of maintaining reliable systems in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment. At Tolman Motorsport, Daniel sees his role as more than just keeping the servers running; he's focused on leveraging data and technology to give the team a competitive edge. 

Daniel is known for his rigorous approach and meticulous planning. He believes in proactive problem-solving and constantly seeks innovative solutions to optimize the team's IT infrastructure. He's also a strong advocate for cybersecurity, understanding the critical importance of protecting sensitive data in the modern racing world. He is not afraid to challenge the status quo, pushing for upgrades and improvements that others might overlook, making him a valuable, if sometimes intense, asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Daniel is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, even at the track.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
Has a whiteboard in his office covered in complex network diagrams.
